{{Quote|Tosh shot himself in the foot rather than face them again.|Sergeant Tenn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Tosh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during [[3642 BBY]]. While preparing for the assault on the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] at the [[Sundari Flatlands]], Tosh and his squad were attacked by mutated [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] from a nearby laboratory. After [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Langstrom]] was killed, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tenn (sergeant)|Tenn]] took over as the commanding officer and retreated with what remained of the squad, before calling for reinforcements. Tosh himself refused to face the Colicoids again and even shot himself in the foot so that he couldn't be forced to.
